pairs.subject: video-assembly
pairs.evidence: lib/cut/deriveTimeline.ts:314 The act-two turn mark is derived from the material's label, but when two scenes match /turn/ the first is taken silently instead of surfacing the double match as a story defect, and two other techniques (silence spotting, drift threshold) are also missed in this context.

techniques.evidence: lib/cut/deriveTimeline.ts:314 Derived from a labelled scene (good), but `find` silently takes the first of several matching scenes; the rule says to surface two candidates as a material defect.

lib/cut/finishLine.ts:99 Cue spans are re-derived from the scenes (deriveTimeline.ts:264), but the finish line fails any second not under a cue as 'unscored'; no spot kind for silence exists, so silence chosen on purpose cannot be told apart from a hole.

lib/cut/finishLine.ts:58 Status is re-derived from the current offset (offsets.ts:37, good), but the tolerance is zero: a clip a few ms off still fails the drift row, against the ~15 ms early / ~45 ms late leave-it threshold, and there is no head/tail measurement.

lib/cut/cutDocument.ts:146 A missing plate compiles to an explicit gap carrying its reason, and the export renders it black and lists it in sidecar gaps; voice lines are drawn as MISSING 'written, not recorded'.
lib/cut/finishLine.ts:93 Coverage is a union reduced over the same music clips that drew the lane, not prose; picture, voice and music are kept in separate lanes.
lib/cut/cutDocument.ts:177 The cut compiles to a deterministic, key-sorted, hashed edit decision list that the export only executes.
lib/musicVideoExport.ts:6 The music-video export calls renderFrameAt(frameIndex) with the same compositor the preview uses.
lib/cutExport.ts:305 A silent stand-in take, which would otherwise mix as plausible narration, becomes an unreachable row that names it; plate-only drawing is declared as `drawn: "plates"`.
lib/cutExport.ts:341 The document's shape and that the picture tiles the clock are checked before any ffmpeg spawn, and the render is a stills animatic; there is no contact-sheet rung.
lib/adRender.ts:384 Generated clips' own sound is explicitly stripped rather than left to occupy a lane; this is the honest 'strip and author in the cut' route.

pairs.registryProposal: drift-correction states a perceptual tolerance (~15 ms early / ~45 ms late) but the golden path also asks for a snap that returns the offset to exactly zero; a technique line saying whether a gate should pass an offset inside the tolerance (vs. requiring zero) would settle whether a zero-tolerance finish gate is a deviation.

app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Cut.tsx:31 Picture, voice and music lanes in a fixed order on one clock (CutClock), with blocks drawn at their drawn start and length.

app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Cut.tsx:106 Missing blocks keep their look and reason; the inspector shows a rose status chip and the reason. Strips.tsx:117 shows a refused card's reason the same way.

app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Score.tsx:47 Each cue is spotted with an in/out on the shared clock and a stated purpose; gaps are shown as a count, not hidden.
